quarterly_data.quarter: QumulusAI press release: QumulusAI Amends Oklahoma Lease, Extending Potential Tenure (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Oklahoma site: QumulusAI amended the surface lease at its Oklahoma data center (approximately 10.57 acres, in service since 2024, the company's legacy operating site), replacing the single five-year renewal option with three consecutive five-year renewal options at the company's election, extending its potential tenure through January 31, 2044 (QumulusAI is not obligated to exercise them). The site carries 19 MW of total contracted power capacity: 10 MW is currently active and supports legacy blockchain mining and hosting operations, and 9 MW is available and unutilized. CFO Scott Krosnowski: the renewal options give long-dated control of an established, energized site, 'and that optionality is what makes the site's available power worth planning around.'
quarterly_data.figure: 19 MW contracted power (10 MW active for legacy mining and hosting, 9 MW available and unutilized); potential tenure through January 31, 2044
